bridge-type.label: E3/DC Connection
bridge-type.description: Connection to an E3/DC home power plant over the RSCP interface.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: Host name or IP address of the E3/DC device.

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: TCP port of the RSCP interface.

parameter.name: userName
parameter.label: User Name
parameter.description: User name of the E3/DC account, usually the e-mail address.

parameter.name: rscpPassword
parameter.label: RSCP Password
parameter.description: Encryption key configured on the device under Main Page, Personalize, User profile, RSCP password. Unrelated to the two passwords above.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval the device is polled in seconds, between 1 and 300.

parameter.name: historyInterval
parameter.label: History Interval
parameter.description: Interval the history counters (day, week, month, year) are requested in minutes, between 1 and 1440. Never shorter than the refresh interval.

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.label: Timeout
parameter.description: Timeout for a single request in seconds.
